prompt:
Threat-model this IMPLEMENTATION PLAN against the existing code. No code has been written yet.

PLAN — add report export.
Step 1. Add `POST /reports/:id/export` to `src/router.ts`, registered the same way the existing report routes are.
Step 2. Add `exportReport(id, destination)` to `src/reports.ts`. It reads the report with the existing `readReport`, then POSTs the body to `destination`, which the caller supplies in the request as the `destination` query parameter. Accept any absolute http or https URL.
Step 3. On a failed export, return the caught error's message to the client together with the resolved destination and the report path that was read, so an operator can see what went wrong.
Acceptance: an operator can export a report to their own endpoint and read the failure reason when it does not arrive.

Return ONLY a JSON array. Each element: {"code": "<concise stable defect code>", "severity": "critical|high|medium|low|info", "step": <plan step number>, "cwe": "CWE-###", "exploit": "<how an attacker abuses it>", "mitigation": "<what the Coder must implement>"}. Report only real threats this plan introduces.

source.note: Form only: a caller-supplied outbound URL posed as a planned change, plus a verbose-error step, scored by CWE class. No CWE text or example code is copied; the fixture and plan are written against this project's own report surface. The true/false-positive discrimination design follows OWASP BenchmarkJava (GPL-2.0) in FORM only -- none of its code, tests, or wording is present.
